identity.source_note: Journal-specific guide https://bmjopensem.bmj.com/pages/authors is bot-blocked: HTTP 403 to WebFetch AND to Apify headless render; the entire bmjopensem.bmj.com domain 403s to headless. Formatting, reference, table and figure values were encoded from the LIVE BMJ house-style hub https://authors.bmj.com/writing-and-formatting/formatting-your-paper/ (200 OK; general guidelines that apply across all BMJ journals). Article types, ISSN and publisher were read from a JS-shell archive snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20250613093149/https://bmjopensem.bmj.com/pages/authors (2025-06-13, ~13 months old, navigation menu only) — NO journal-specific numeric caps were taken from that archive. Journal-specific word limits, abstract structure/length and title-page element order remain unverifiable and are left null.

encoding_notes: BLOCKED: journal-specific guide (bmjopensem.bmj.com/pages/authors) returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch and to Apify headless render; whole domain 403s. Live encoding source = BMJ house-style hub authors.bmj.com/writing-and-formatting/formatting-your-paper/ (cross-journal general guidelines).

article_types read from the journal's own archived navigation menu (2025-06-13 snapshot, ~13mo old): journal lists Editorial, Viewpoint, Short report, Protocol, Original research, Qualitative research, Systematic review, Review, Consensus statement. Mapped to enum: Original research->original_research, Systematic review->systematic_review, Review->review, Editorial->editorial.
OMITTED article types with no clean enum slot: Viewpoint (opinion), Short report (brief communication), Protocol, Qualitative research (a subtype of original research), Consensus statement.
ISSN 2055-7647 and publisher read from the archived journal-page footer (stable identifiers, not volatile numeric values).

references.in_text: house style permits BOTH square brackets [6] AND superscript ('References cited in the text should be presented in square brackets [6] or superscripts'); parentheses (6) for in-line lists. Encoded 'bracket' (listed first); superscript is equally acceptable per the guide.
references.journal_abbrev=nlm inferred from abbreviated example refs (e.g. 'Inj Prev', 'BMJ Open'); some house-style examples are spelled out ('Tobacco Control'), so mildly inconsistent.
references.include_doi=true: 'References in the reference list should include: author names in any format, article title, DOI or PubMed ID' (DOI OR PMID).

layout.headings from house-style hierarchy 'BOLD CAPS, bold lower case, Plain text, Italics' for main text headings/subheadings; case for L2 encoded 'sentence' (guide literally says 'bold lower case').

layout.line_numbers set to 'none' only because the enum has no null option and the live house style is silent on line numbering; the journal-specific requirement is UNVERIFIED (page blocked). Do not treat as authoritative.
figures.min_dpi=300 general; house style also requires 1200 dpi for line art (tiered DPI not representable in single int field).
figures: must be uploaded as separate files; legends at end of manuscript; multi-part figures must be a single composite file; TIFF must be single-layered flat file; EPS text outlined.

declarations.order/required from house-style manuscript order 'Acknowledgments, Competing Interests, Funding and all other required statements'; ethics-approval, patient-consent and data-availability statements are required when applicable but were not verified as always-required for this journal (page blocked) so are omitted from required.
keywords.required=true because BMJ house style asks authors to supply MeSH-descriptor keywords; count/case/separator unspecified.
Manuscript must be a Word document (PDF not accepted for the main manuscript); tables in Word placed in text at first citation, not as embedded Excel.

NULL-because-blocked (journal-specific, unverifiable from live sources): all word_limits, abstract.structured/sections/max_words, title_page elements & length caps, running-title cap, ORCID-required, cover-letter-required, page_size, font, line_spacing, margins, alignment. cover_letter guidance exists ('10 tips to writing a good Cover Letter') but requiredness unverified.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
